purpose: One newly computed exact Q4 edge-subgraph optimum with a saved frontier, complete continuation records, and a fresh saved reader.

primary_conventions.author: Rahil Baber
primary_conventions.title: Turán densities of hypercubes
primary_conventions.read_scope: Introduction, cube coordinates/layers, arbitrary edge subgraphs and classical alternating-layer construction

source_contract.relation: The finite object is an arbitrary simple edge subgraph on all 16 vertices of Q4. The open problem concerns all sufficiently large dimensions at every fixed positive epsilon above one-half density.
source_contract.attribution: The alternating-layer baseline is established mathematics. This consumer claims one bounded computed optimum with a transparent certificate, not mathematical priority or a new asymptotic bound.

conventions.vertices: nonnegative binary integers; bit zero is least significant
conventions.edges: direction first, then increasing lower endpoint with that direction bit zero
conventions.squares: coordinate pair i<j first, then increasing base with both bits zero
conventions.graph: arbitrary undirected simple edge subset on the entire fixed cube vertex set
conventions.objective: minimize deleted edges that hit every coordinate square
conventions.solution_scope: one optimum witness only; equal-size alternatives may be pruned
conventions.semantic_premise: retained compiler and search records; saved opening is not independent proof verification

limitations: The saved reader validates dimensions, types, ids, masks, partitions, references and frontier presence; it does not independently establish topology semantics, square coverage, pruning inequalities or the completed mathematical proof.
The exact result is finite Q4. It does not resolve the limiting half-density question.
Equal-size branches may be pruned; this is not a catalog of every maximum graph or an isomorphism classification.
A bounded run with a nonempty frontier remains incomplete unless the separate attained global lower bound closes it.
The implementation has explicit dimension, search, session, event, page and copy bounds; arbitrary dimensions or unbounded exhaustive search are outside its contract.
Work counters count declared operations and records; they are not a count of every V8 instruction. Timings are single observations, not benchmark claims.
